label: Updated 8 AM ET
title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today’s biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Niemann's 8th LIV Title
items.text: Joaquin Niemann won LIV Golf Korea in a playoff over Talor Gooch, marking his eighth LIV title, the most since 2022, amid LIV's search for $250-350M funding after Saudi PIF announced 2026 exit.

items.headline: Potgieter’s NCAA Bogey Record
items.text: Louisiana's Malan Potgieter extended his bogey-free streak to 91 holes at the NCAA Championship, breaking the unofficial NCAA record and closing in on Tiger Woods’ pro record of 110 straight bogey-free holes.
